latest_release.name: v2.3.0
latest_release.body: Highlights: - 🪟[Experimentally support HCS driver](https://lima-vm.io/docs/config/vmtype/hcs/) for eliminating QEMU dependency (Windows hosts) - 🍎[Attach host block devices to VZ guests](https://lima-vm.io/docs/config/disk/#attach-host-block-devices) (macOS hosts) - 🐧[Experimentally support `lima:shared`, `lima:host`, and `lima:bridged` networks](https://lima-vm.io/docs/config/network/) (Linux hosts) - 🖥️`limactl menu`: an experimental menu-based user interface ## Changes - Windows host support: - Experimentally support HCS driver (#5449 #5514, thanks to [LFX mentee](https://lfx.linuxfoundation.org/tools/mentorship/) @mie313, and @unsuman) - Support native Windows OpenSSH (#5298 #5299 #5300 #5337, thanks to @jandubois) - Automatically append common tool directories (e.g., QEMU) to `PATH` (#5348, thanks to [LFX mentee](https://lfx.linuxfoundation.org/tools/mentorship/) @mie313) - Windows guest support: - Support `provision` (#5263, thanks to [LFX mentee](https://lfx.linuxfoundation.org/tools/mentorship/) @mie313) - macOS guest support: - Add `osOpts.darwin.suppressFirstLoginSetup` to skip the first-login Setup Assistant (#5336, thanks to @trodemaster) - VZ: - Support attaching host block devices (`limactl start --block-device`) (#5117, thanks to @pirate) - Add `audio.microphone` to attach a capture stream (#5462, thanks to @iamstarkov) - Add `networkOpts.hostLoopback` to block guest access to the host's loopback services (#5581, thanks to @ranacseruet) - QEMU: - Support `nestedVirtualization` with HVF (QEMU >= 11.1) (#5443, thanks to @sharanrajt) - Implement `limactl screenshot` (#5478, thanks to @afbjorklund) - krunkit: - Warn when a read-only mount is requested (#5740) - Networking: - Experimentally support `lima:shared`, `lima:host`, and `lima:bridged` networks on Linux hosts, via the new `lima-privileged-net` helper (#5483 #5484 #5485 #5486 #5513 #5669, thanks to @unsuman) - SSH: - Verify the guest VM's SSH host key, even for locally forwarded ports (#5687) - Port forwarding: - Forward Unix sockets over gRPC instead of SSH (#5653, thanks to @KayleMaster) - YAML: - Add `archVariant` (`--arch-variant`) for selecting x86-64-v2/v3 images (#5335, thanks to @ekalinin) - `additionalDisks`: support custom `mountPoint` and optional mounting (#5198, thanks to @ekalinin) - `copyToHost`: add `skipIfMissing` (#5183, thanks to @afbjorklund) - Warn when overlapping mounts are detected (#5748) - `limactl` CLI: - Add `limactl menu`, an experimental TUI for managing instances (#5330 #5629 #5668 ..., thanks to @Soumya-codr et al.) - `limactl` without arguments now opens the menu on an interactive terminal - Support stopping multiple instances with `limactl stop` (#5369, thanks to @MEETNANDA8107) - `limactl autostart enable`: add `--keep-alive` (#5086, thanks to @resker) - `limactl shell --sync`: add `--sync-exclude` and support the `.limasyncignore` file (#4917, thanks to @peschmae) - Show the boot progress with an `(N/total)` counter (#4902 #5602, thanks to @mn-ram and @saswatsam786) - MCP: - Implement the `replace` tool for targeted file edits (#5540, thanks to @bonifaido) - nerdctl: - Update from v2.4.1 to [v2.4.2](https://github.com/containerd/nerdctl/releases/tag/v2.4.2) (#5703) - Templates: - Update the default Ubuntu (`default`, `ubuntu`, ...) to 26.10 (#5657) - Update Fedora (`fedora`, `podman`, ...) to 45 (#5694m #5734, thanks to @kolyshin) - Update openSUSE Leap (`opensuse-leap`) to 16.1 (#5735, thanks to @e-minguez) - `oraclelinux-8`, `centos-stream`: Drop legacy BIOS configuration (#5710) - `k8s`: Add a parameter for apt-proxy (#5251, thanks to @afbjorklund) - `k8s`: Allow installing on the minimal image variant (#5385, thanks to @afbjorklund) - `k8s`: Pin Kubernet
